title: depmod: ERROR: zstd: Data corruption detected
body: Hi, A recent update on one of my Arch instances generated the following message: (15/20) Updating module dependencies... depmod: ERROR: zstd: Data corruption detected depmod: ERROR: failed to load symbols from /lib/modules/7.2.9-arch1-1/kernel/drivers/net/can/usb/etas_es58x/etas_es58x.ko.zst: Invalid argument depmod: ERROR: zstd: Data corruption detected depmod: ERROR: zstd: Data corruption detected I can't imagine what could have caused it, I think the disk is okay, it's a Samsung SSD formatted with EXT4. Manually decompression seems to work ok: $ ls -l /lib/modules/7.2.9-arch1-1/kernel/drivers/net/can/usb/etas_es58x/ total 36 -rw-r--r-- 1 root root 35803 Oct 3 12:43 etas_es58x.ko.zst $ zstd -d /lib/modules/7.2.9-arch1-1/kernel/drivers/net/can/usb/etas_es58x/etas_es58x.ko.zst -o etas_es58x.ko /lib/modules/7.2.9-arch1-1/kernel/drivers/net/can/usb/etas_es58x/etas_es58x.ko.zst: 165336 bytes $ ls -l total 164 -rw-r--r-- 1 rob rob 165336 Oct 3 12:43 etas_es58x.ko Is this likely to be just a one-off?
